batchRequest.request: Replace the line chart with an area chart and add a currency exchange table.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, indexBlock, chartCard, moversCard])
header = InlineHeader("Market Summary", "Daily snapshot of major indices")
indexBlock = OverviewCardBlock([o1, o2, o3])
o1 = OverviewCardItem("sp", o1top, o1m)
o1top = IconText(o1i, "neutral", "m", "S&P 500", "US Large Cap", true, "horizontal")
o1i = Icon("trending-up", "finance")
o1m = MetricIndicatorInline("5,254.35", "vs prior close", { direction: "up", value: 0.62 })
o2 = OverviewCardItem("nas", o2top, o2m)
o2top = IconText(o2i, "neutral", "m", "NASDAQ", "US Tech", true, "horizontal")
o2i = Icon("cpu", "finance")
o2m = MetricIndicatorInline("16,438.12", "vs prior close", { direction: "up", value: 0.91 })
o3 = OverviewCardItem("dow", o3top, o3m)
o3top = IconText(o3i, "neutral", "m", "Dow Jones", "US Blue Chip", true, "horizontal")
o3i = Icon("landmark", "finance")
o3m = MetricIndicatorInline("39,127.80", "vs prior close", { direction: "down", value: 0.18 })
chartCard = Card([chartHead, weekChart])
chartHead = CardHeader("This Week", "Index closing values, indexed to 100 at Monday")
weekChart = LineChart(days, [sp, nas, dow], "natural", "Day", "Indexed Value")
days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]
sp = Series("S&P 500", [100, 100.4, 100.2, 100.9, 101.3])
nas = Series("NASDAQ", [100, 100.7, 100.3, 101.2, 102.0])
dow = Series("Dow Jones", [100, 99.9, 100.1, 99.8, 99.6])
moversCard = Card([moversHead, moversTable])
moversHead = CardHeader("Top Movers", "Largest daily percentage changes")
moversTable = Table([Col("Symbol", syms), Col("Company", names), Col("Price ($)", prices, "number"), Col("Change (%)", changes, "number")])
syms = ["NVDA", "TSLA", "AMD", "META", "INTC", "NKE"]
names = ["NVIDIA", "Tesla", "AMD", "Meta Platforms", "Intel", "Nike"]
prices = [892.45, 178.20, 164.80, 498.10, 30.65, 94.30]
changes = [4.82, 3.15, 2.67, -2.41, -3.38, -4.05]
request: Replace the line chart with an area chart and add a currency exchange table.
